name: Hydroxymethanesulfinic acid
description: Hydroxymethanesulfinic acid ( CAS 79-25-4 ), commercially supplied as its sodium salt form, is a reducing agent used across textile, paper, and cleaning industries. It functions primarily as a bleaching and stripping agent. The compound works by breaking down colorants and oxidized compounds under controlled conditions. In textile and leather processing, it serves as a discharge agent for vat and reactive dyes, enabling precise color removal. This chemical allows for effective processing without damaging fiber substrates. Paper manufacturers use it to brighten mechanical pulp and control residual color in recycled fiber streams during the production process. In industrial and institutional cleaning formulations, it targets stubborn stains and oxidized soils where conventional alkaline cleaners fall short. It provides a specialized solution for difficult cleaning tasks. Water treatment operations apply it as a reducing agent to neutralize excess oxidants such as chlorine or hydrogen peroxide prior to discharge. This ensures that effluent meets environmental safety requirements. This product is available in powder and granular forms, with the sodium salt being the predominant commercial grade supplied to industrial buyers. Technical-grade specifications are standard across most supply channels. Purity levels and active content are typically confirmed by titration or redox assay to ensure consistency.
